# One Still Point

> A scientifically grounded, GPU-accelerated, animated black hole visualizer — a single-page
> WebGPU app (three.js TSL raymarcher with an N-body companion system, gravitational lensing,
> an accretion disk, tidal disruption, and a DVR-style history timeline). Free, no accounts,
> no tracking.

- [The app](https://onestillpoint.app/): the visualizer itself (requires WebGPU or WebGL2).
- [Source + docs](https://github.com/cportka/one-still-point): README, physics validation
  scripts, the intro script, and dev deep-dives under docs/.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/cportka/one-still-point/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): no data leaves
  the page.

Created by Chris Portka. The tagline: "The worldline · The present resting place · The circle
of eternal return · The spinning cycle of time".
